messages:
nate: deploy-bot reports a sustained p99 regression (+250ms) on hosted text-gen after the 4.1.0 rollout. Autorollback scheduled in 15m. tagging ops for immediate vet/hold. telemetry: https://internal.redwood/telemetry/3189990000

deploy-bot: [ALERT] Hosted text-gen p99 +250ms vs baseline. Throughput: 5.5k RPS. Suggested action: AUTO-ROLLBACK -> v4.0.7 in 15m unless overridden. Suspected: batching kernel change.

maya: i'm oncall. quick check: error-rate unaffected, only tail latency. might be a batching aggregation edgecase on long contexts. prefer to hold 10m to validate route-level routing before rolling back globally.

ops-oncall: i agree with maya. global rollback would disrupt dedicated pools and some customers. propose targeted routing fallback for text-gen route first (route-level fallback to compatible variant), run synthetic load, then decide. request to reduce autorollback timer to 10m.

nate: lowering timer to 10m OK. plan: at +2m run 1k req synthetic across text-gen long-contexts, at +5m evaluate traces, at +8m run a routing fallback to variant v4.0.7 for 10% traffic. if p99 persists >+150ms at +10m, then manual rollback.

sre-bot: NOTE: autorollback timer adjusted to 10m by operator override. Current timer: 10m. Also posting quick playbook link: /runbooks/rollback-text-gen

maya: starting synthetic now -> `hey loadtest --route text-gen --ctx 2048 --rps 200 --duration 60s`

ops-oncall: synthetic done. p99 under synthetic at +140ms (better than observed in prod). traces show spikes correlated with backend batching flush events around 1k tokens.

rebecca: i can deploy a targeted routing fallback: `infra traffic-slice --route text-gen --variant v4.0.7 --from 0%->10% --window 20s`. recommend starting at +8m as planned.

nate: execute fallback at +8m. will watch telemetry. if p99 normalizes, abort rollback and keep monitoring with 30m watch.

ops-oncall: traffic-slice executed. 10% traffic on v4.0.7 now. immediate p99 drop observed on that 10% slice (~-220ms). whole-prod aggregate p99 improved ~-50ms but still above baseline.

maya: good signal. suggests regression in v4.1.0 batching kernel under certain burst patterns. we should avoid autorollback for full fleet; instead expand fallback progressively while eng-runtime crafts patch. propose 10%->50% over 15m and then reassess.

nate: agreed. abort autorollback. expanding fallback to 50% now. rebecca please coordinate a public postmortem note draft for release notes team, mark release notes freeze until patch.

deploy-bot: ACTION: autorollback canceled by operator. Monitoring state: fallback-expanded 50% to variant v4.0.7 for text-gen.

ops-oncall: putting a hold on release notes and tagging eng-runtime on INF-5012 (batching kernel regression). I'll keep 30m watch and escalate if p99 worsens.

rebecca: drafting internal note: "We observed p99 tail latency regression in v4.1.0 on hosted text-gen. We executed a targeted routing fallback to v4.0.7 (50% traffic) which improved p99. Autorollback was canceled. Patch in flight." will post after legal review.

nate: thanks team. closing this thread once fallback steady for 30m. if anyone sees re-escalation ping here. :thumbsup:
